title: The WittVectors package for Macaulay2
summary: We implement a Macaulay2 package for computations involving rings of truncated Witt vectors $W_n(R)$ of a finitely generated $\F_p$-algebra $R$. This package includes ring operations (addition, multiplication, Frobenius, Verschiebung, etc.) on elements of $W_n(R)$, conversion between tuple representatives and ghost map representatives of elements of truncated Witt vectors over polynomial rings, and explicit computation of $W_n(R)$ as a finite-type algebra over $\Z/p^n$.
